---
title: Choose a payment model
description: Match the charging contract to the workload without claiming upstream features Lucid does not implement.
icon: Scale
status: next
verifiedVersion: 3.0.0
verifiedAt: 2026-07-20
product: sdk
---

| Workload | Use now | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Deterministic request with a known price | x402 `exact` | The buyer knows the full charge before fulfillment |
| Invoke and stream have different fixed prices | Per-mode Lucid price | Each operation advertises one exact amount |
| Credential-backed charge or session | MPP | Use only after installing the Next-only MPP extension |
| Unknown usage before completion | Design a bounded fixed tier | Lucid does not currently expose x402 `upto` settlement |
| Many payments settled together | Not currently supported | x402 batch settlement is upstream capability, not Lucid support |

Prices are USD decimal strings: `"0.01"` means one cent in the configured USDC
asset. Atomic token amounts appear in protocol payloads and accounting, not in
the entrypoint's human-readable price field.

Do not model an unbounded workload as a cheap fixed call. Bound input size,
runtime, tokens, or output, then price the bounded service. For long-running
work, use an [asynchronous task](/docs/build/async-tasks) so payment admission
and fulfillment state remain visible.
